name: Sands of Flame (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a desert land where fiery magic is seen as a mark of greatness, spurring those in search of power to master flames.

Imperial Training: war scepter

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes additional fire damage equal to 1/2 your emissary level whenever they take fire damage (minimum 1 damage). Additionally, when the mark is expended, the target takes an additional 1d8 fire damage.

Imperial Origin Abilities
Solar Burst (Sp)

At 1st level, you can create a 5-foot radius burst at a spot within 60 feet. All creatures within the burst take 1d4 fire damage plus 1d4 per 3 levels after 1st. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier) halves this damage. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Scorching Sands (Sp)

At 7th level, you are able to cast the spell burning sands as a spell like ability usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Blazing Lens (Sp)

At 14th level, you unleash a flash of burning light as a standard action. All enemies within a 20-foot cone take 1d6 fire damage per even caster level you possess. A Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier) halves this damage.

Allies in the area gain the effects of haste for 1 round but it can only be used on either movement or taking an extra attack, not both. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.
